hook.title: Source: a call into this fork's modules
hook.rule: Take upstream's side of the conflict, then put the call back at the same point. The reason names the module called; its tests under `packages/opencode/test/rafiki` and `test/brand` fail if the call is lost.

text.title: Source: product name, file names and wording
text.rule: Take upstream's side, then replace the literal with the value from the brand module again. `test/brand/upstream-names.test.ts` fails on a string that still names the upstream product.

logic.title: Source: behaviour changed in place
logic.rule: Merge by hand and read both sides. These are the files to thin next: move the behaviour behind a call, or offer the fix upstream.

test.title: Tests of upstream, adapted
test.rule: Take upstream's side, then apply the expectation of this product again. A test upstream removed is removed here too.

generated.title: Generated files
generated.rule: Never merge by hand. Take either side, finish the merge, then regenerate the file with the command given in the merge procedure.

identity.title: Package identity and packaging
identity.rule: Keep this fork's name, version and binary name. Take every other change upstream made to the file.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.rule: Keep this fork's text. Read what upstream changed and carry over what is true here.

ci.title: Repository tooling and workflows
ci.rule: Keep this fork's change. A workflow inherited from upstream must stay inert in this repository.

extension.title: Editor extension
extension.rule: Keep this fork's side entirely: the extension is this product's own. Read what upstream changed for anything worth carrying over.
